title: Two-lane ramp
done: Two trucks, side by side, up the ramp and away! Who flies furthest?

steps.say: Put a big green square flat on the table. It is a road with two lanes.
Stand a ring of 6 squares where the ramp will rest.
Lean a big red square up onto the ring. One big square is a ramp for two trucks!
Leave a gap, then lay a yellow square flat. The trucks land here!
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
One more square, flat on the table, next to the last.
